# Selectable Buttons

Selectable Button fields allow publishers to choose either multiple or single items from a list depending on the setting.

:::note
The following examples use a field named `buttons_field`. This should be replaced with your field name.
:::

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.buttons_field }}

{% for value, label in entry.buttons_field.options %}
    {{ label }} - {{ value }}
{% endfor %}

{% for value, label in entry.buttons_field.selected %}
    {{ label }} - {{ value }}
{% endfor %}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{{ $entry->buttons_field }}

@foreach($entry->buttons_field->options as $value => $label)
    {{ $label }} - {{ $value }}
@endforeach

@foreach($entry->buttons_field->selected as $value => $label)
    {{ $label }} - {{ $value }}
@endforeach
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Parameters


<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.buttons_field.parameters({limit: 1, markup: 'ul'}) | raw }}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{!! $entry->buttons_field->parameters([limit: 1, markup: 'ul']) !!}
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>
